payload.description: A target for anything tenants are asked about. The Regulator of Social Housing makes every landlord publish a set of tenant satisfaction measures, and Norwich publishes 22 of them on this page: 75.3% of tenants satisfied with the overall service, up from 71.1%, and 30.0% satisfied with how complaints are handled. But the regulator does not require a target and Norwich has not set one, so none of them can be scored. A figure with nothing to compare it against is a figure, not a verdict, and we will not invent the standard.
